acceptance.criterion: 应用前重新读取比对指纹，仅修改精确目标，冲突不覆盖。
保存后重索引并验证结果；Markdown 继续默认只读，失败保留原始文件或恢复依据。

limitations: Feature-local verification and actual project developer self-use only; full regression, E4 scenarios, benchmarks, platform validation and release remain scheduled.

Writer normalizes the selected mapping into JSON flow syntax and may change formatting/comments inside that record; bytes outside the selected mapping are preserved. Unsupported shapes/fields, Markdown and Git sources retain an approved manual proposal. Work state/ownership/blocker actions are P6-003; complete dependency/acceptance/evidence gates are P6-004.

AWR serializes its own writers per source and repeats fingerprint checks. Atomic rename does not provide filesystem compare-and-swap against unrelated editors; simultaneous external edits in the final check/rename interval are outside this component proof. Recovery snapshots are retained; failed start receipts may leave unreferenced staging data.

Actor metadata is caller reported. Interruption tests reproduce persisted phase boundaries and local SQLite event failures; they are not a platform-wide kill/power-loss or independent real-client acceptance campaign.
